title: Azizul wins again at national meet even without speed suit and shoe cover
snippet: Azizul wins again at national meet even without speed suit and shoe cover 'raw diamond' in search for next track cycling 'raw diamond' in search for next track
extractedText: Azizul posing with his gold medal. NILAI: Track cyclist Azizulhasni Awang showed he is on the right track to shine at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow next month after nailing a hattrick of wins at the National Championships in Nilai.Azizul, representing Team Azizul, put up a blistering ride to win the men’s elite 1km time trial event with a time of 1:01.134s at the National Velodrome yesterday.
